user.title: WoW Blizzard API Setup
user.description: Enter your Battle.net API credentials. You can create them at {setup_url}

features.title: Feature Selection
features.description: Choose which features to enable for region {region}. You can change these later in integration options.

data.enable_character_details: Enable character details (professions, stats, talents, reputations, ...)
data.enable_region_data: Enable WoW Token price and weekly reset
data.enable_mythic_leaderboard: Mythic+ realm leaderboards and weekly affixes (about 8 MB per realm and hour)
data.auction_items: Item IDs for auction prices (comma separated, empty = off)

character.title: Add Character - Game Version
character.description: Select the World of Warcraft game version for the character you want to add. Current characters: {character_count}

character_details.title: Add Character - Details
character_details.description: Select the realm and enter the character name for your {game_version} character.

character_menu.title: WoW Characters Manager
character_menu.description:
Currently added characters ({character_count}):
{character_list}

Choose your next action.

remove_character.title: Remove Character(s)
remove_character.description: Select which character(s) you would like to remove from monitoring. You currently have {character_count} character(s) configured.

add_method.title: Add characters
add_method.description: Add a character by hand, or log in with Battle.net to pick characters from your account. The login needs `https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/oauth` as redirect URL of your Battle.net API client.

account_login.title: Battle.net login
account_login.description: Log in with Battle.net in the window that opened.

account_select.title: Characters of your account
account_select.description: Open a game version and a realm, then tick the characters to add ({character_count} available, already configured ones are hidden).

account_failed.title: Battle.net login not completed
account_failed.description: Nothing is lost. Continue to add characters by hand or try the login again. If this keeps failing, check that `https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/oauth` is a redirect URL of your Battle.net API client.

account_options.title: Account data
account_options.description:
{selected_count} character(s) selected.

The Battle.net login can also be kept to load gold per character, total gold and account collections. Blizzard limits logins to 24 hours; afterwards the values keep their last state, everything else keeps working, and you can log in again via Reconfigure whenever you like.

data.keep_login: Load account data (gold, account collections) while the login is valid

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Battle.net API
error.character_not_found: Character not found or not accessible
error.character_already_added: This character has already been added
error.game_version_unavailable: This game version is not available in the Blizzard API yet
error.account_login_failed: The Battle.net login failed or was cancelled
error.oauth_redirect_unavailable: Home Assistant could not build the login redirect. Enable My Home Assistant (part of default_config).

abort.already_configured: This character configuration is already set up
abort.no_characters: At least one character must be kept
abort.account_login_skipped: Battle.net login not completed, the configuration is unchanged

init.title: World of Warcraft Integration Options
init.description: Select the action you want to perform. You currently have {character_count} character(s) configured.

features.title: Configure Integration Features
features.description: Toggle which features are enabled. These changes will reload the integration automatically.

data.enable_mythic_leaderboard: Mythic+ realm leaderboards & affixes (about 8 MB per realm and hour)
data.auction_items: Item IDs for auction prices (comma separated, empty = off)

add_character.title: Add Character - Game Version
add_character.description: Select the game version of the character you want to add.

add_character_details.title: Add Character - Details
add_character_details.description: Select the realm and name for your {game_version} character.

remove_character.title: Remove Character(s)
remove_character.description: Select the character(s) you want to remove. You must keep at least 1 character configured.

remove_account.title: Remove Battle.net login
remove_account.description: The integration forgets the Battle.net login. Gold and account sensors are removed; characters and all other data stay. You can log in again any time with Reconfigure.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Battle.net API
error.character_not_found: Character not found or not accessible
error.character_already_added: This character has already been added
error.game_version_unavailable: This game version is not available in the Blizzard API yet

account_login_expired.title: Battle.net login expired
account_login_expired.description: The Battle.net login of the World of Warcraft integration has expired (Blizzard limits logins to 24 hours). Everything else keeps working; gold and account values keep their last state. To update them, open the integration and choose **Reconfigure**. If you do not need account data, choose **Configure > Remove Battle.net login**, or ignore this notice.
